pages.text: Combine a $(item)Combat Slime + Ancient Command Seal$() without a fixed arrangement. Identity, ownership, growth, current health, gear, and cargo remain. Restoring an Ancient Guard core at a pedestal offers a second route.

Starts waiting. Select Fight to assign its current position as the guard post. It fights eligible targets within Detection Range of the post and returns when idle. Select Fight again after moving it to assign a new post.

Accepts a sword, shield, and Slime Armor. While working with a shield, it takes 35% of combat damage aimed at an owner or cooperating companion within four blocks. Sight, target filters, ownership, and PvP protection apply. Guards do not pass damage to other guards.

Protection costs at least four stamina, up to twice the intercepted damage, and cannot take health below one. Tool supply, hauling, healing, Herald reports, Commander orders, and portal travel use the existing companion systems. Restored veterans retain ancient names and weathered insignia.
